body.headline: France Drafts UN Resolution on Hormuz as European Nations Back India's Permanent Security Council Bid
body.whatHappened: France has drafted a United Nations resolution for an international mission to restore shipping through the Strait of Hormuz to stabilize international energy markets. At the UN, Greek Foreign Minister Gerapetritis met with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to call for an immediate Middle East ceasefire and restored freedom of navigation. Meanwhile, European nations have moved to support India's 30-year push for a permanent UN Security Council seat amid calls from Prime Minister Modi for urgent reform, though the overall UN reform process remains stalled over seat allocation and regional disputes.
body.affectsMe: As an Indian expat living in Berlin, seeing European governments formally endorse India's bid for a permanent UN Security Council seat highlights shifting geopolitical alignment between your home country and Europe, while France's initiative to secure Hormuz shipping aims to avert global energy market shocks that can drive up utility and living expenses across Germany.
body.talkingPoint: Between France's UN resolution to police Hormuz shipping and European backing for India's permanent Security Council seat, European diplomacy is heavily focused on shoring up both energy stability and major global partnerships.

body.headline: PM Modi to Chair Union Ministers' Chintan Shivirs as Rahul Gandhi Confronts Centre on Student Infrastructure
body.whatHappened: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to chair a series of 'chintan shivirs' with Union Ministers at Seva Teerth, starting Wednesday afternoon and continuing through a full-day session on Thursday, with all Cabinet ministers expected to take part. Meanwhile, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi targeted Modi during his 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' outreach event in Indore—for which Digvijaya Singh reported approximately 1.5 lakh students had registered—demanding accountability over the shortage of female student hostels and accusing the BJP-RSS of undermining the country's education system. Separately, both Modi and Gandhi extended condolences on the passing of 46-year-old CNN-News18 senior journalist Payal Mehta in Mumbai.
body.affectsMe: While building Prepty from Berlin, keeping tabs on debates over India's education system and the real-world safety and accommodation obstacles faced by students highlights the broader structural environment in which Indian learners operate.
body.talkingPoint: With Modi convening his full Cabinet for internal brainstorming at Seva Teerth, the opposition is attempting to corner the government on student welfare issues like the acute shortage of female hostels.

body.headline: HMA Expands NBA Coverage by Merging Credentialed Reporting and Independent Creator Media
body.whatHappened: ClutchPoints reported that HMA is expanding its NBA coverage, bridging a longstanding divide in sports media between credentialed reporters—who provide team access and direct sourcing—and independent digital creators who focus on personality and modern audience habits.
body.affectsMe: While developing web applications like Forgey and Prepty using Next.js and TypeScript in Berlin, watching digital media models shift toward independent creator dynamics offers useful cues for designing user engagement and content workflows.
body.talkingPoint: Sports coverage is increasingly fusing traditional credentialed access with the audience-first formats developed by independent creators.
